rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes a thermo-mechanical treatment (deformation + phase-selective annealing) to induce recrystallization, while the target uses a high-pressure, high-temperature (HPHT) treatment without intentional deformation. These are different kinds of interventions.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies intermediate annealing temperatures and quasi-static room-temperature testing, whereas the target uses 6 GPa pressure at 1473 K for 2 hours. The conditions are entirely different regimes.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes selective recrystallization, strain partitioning, and delayed crack initiation, while the target relies on coherent interface formation enabling dislocation transfer and multiple deformation mechanisms. These are different mechanisms.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts increased strength and ductility (targeting ~2 GPa and ~35%), while the target achieved ~1150 MPa and ~36%. The property and direction are the same, but the strength magnitude is different.
